newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac, Kohl totally determined to launch EMU in 99.
newsitem.headline: Chirac, Kohl totally determined to launch EMU in 99.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl reiterated their determination to launch a single currency on time in 1999 in talks in Bonn on Wednesday, a French official source said on Thursday.
"They emphasised their total determination to launch the euro at the scheduled date," he said.

The official said Kohl and Chirac also agreed to work closely together for a successful outcome of the European Union's intergovernmental conference on institutional reform at a summit in Amsterdam in June.
The two leaders, who met in Bonn on Wednesday evening for informal talks, agreed to meet several more times before that summit, he said.
